text_block_list.name: Pisa's Friend
text_block_list.text:
That was so suspenseful! I'm so glad the 
main couple ended up together in the end, 
though! ...Wait, huh!? Pisa!?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I-I am terribly sorry... I was overjoyed 
to see the two of you united, but—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
When I think about the one who wasn't 
chosen as the main character... ...ugh.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Was there really no way... to reach an 
ending where everyone stood together in 
harmony...?

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Friend
text_block_list.text:
I get it, but still...! Stepping down like 
that is kind of part of her charm too... 
Anyway, let's just calm down for a second! 
Okay!?
